description: Wrap FLAC3D structural elements with PFC walls. PFC walls are, by definition, edge-connected sets of triangular facets without any non-manifold conditions (i.e., facets penetrating one another, multiple facets sharing one edge, etc). The provided range is applied to FLAC3D shell-based structural elements, filtering the structural elements that are considered for wrapping.

keywords.name: angle
keywords.description: Only consider elements with normal within f degrees of the initial shell element, as specified with the starting-shell keyword.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Add the group name s to shell elements that are coupled via PFC wall facets. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. Options: remove: Remove s from the shell elements. If a slot is not specified, the group name is removed from all slots it is found in.; slot <s>: Assign the group to the slot named s. The default slot name is Default.

keywords.name: name
keywords.description: Set the wall name to s. If a coupled wall with this name exists, new facets, corresponding to shell elements, are added to this wall. If the wall does not exist, a new coupled wall is created. If no name is specified, the wall name is set to wallstructureXX where XX is the next available wall ID.

keywords.name: skip-errors
keywords.description: Skip any errors when stitching together the wall facets from shell elements.

keywords.name: starting-shell
keywords.description: Select the first shell element to be added. i is the component ID of the shell element. This shell element should be within the model domain (see the model domain command).

examples.description: Wrap structural shell elements with a PFC wall

notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
3D only live: the 2D binaries have no wall-structure command (7.00 and 9.8).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): accepted on PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 (without shell elements it answers 'No faceted wall has been added'); rejected at the top level on both 2D consoles and on 6.00.
